description: Non-destructive compression gateway for AI coding agents. Cuts token bills 25% on turn 1 to past 85% in long or saturated sessions, and fits ~3× more turns in the same context window. Powered by our open-source code-native 4B model. Drop-in for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenHands, and any BASE_URL agent.
